WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.throws,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.player_id) as col2
  FROM manager_award ma
  JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.throws
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(col2) as col1
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.throws as col1,
    s1.col2 as col2,
    CAST(s1.col2 AS REAL) / s2.col1 as col3
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.col1 IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(col3) as col1
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.col1,
    s3.col2,
    s3.col3,
    s3.col3 - s4.col1 as col4
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.col3 > s4.col1
)
SELECT 
  SUM(col2) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(col3) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(col4) as avg_difference
FROM step5
